title: Proxmox
description: The Proxmox cluster from pve-exporter (job="pve"): quorum, the four NUCs, every guest ranked worst first, and the storage pools. Pick guests in the dropdown, or click one, to see them alone. Every NUC's exporter reports the whole cluster, so every series is deduplicated by id. Replaces the vendored Proxmox via Prometheus (grafana.com 10347), which showed one exporter instance at a time. docs/design/observability.md.

panels.title: Quorum
panels.description: Whether the Proxmox cluster has quorum. Not quorate when any NUC's pve-exporter reports it lost; without quorum no guest can start, stop or change.

targets.expr: min(pve_cluster_info{quorate="1"} or pve_cluster_info * 0)

panels.title: Nodes online
panels.description: Cluster members Proxmox reports online.

targets.expr: count(max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"node/.*"}) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodes offline
panels.description: Cluster members Proxmox reports offline.

targets.expr: count(max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"node/.*"}) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Guests running
panels.description: Selected VMs and containers running (templates excluded).

targets.expr: count((max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}) == 1) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Guests stopped
panels.description: Selected VMs and containers stopped. A guest can be stopped on purpose; the Guests table names it.

targets.expr: count((max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}) == 0) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU used
panels.description: CPU the four NUCs use, as a share of all their cores.

targets.expr: sum(max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"node/.*"} * pve_cpu_usage_limit{id=~"node/.*"})) / sum(max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_limit{id=~"node/.*"}))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory the four NUCs use, as a share of their total. The NUCs run above 80 % by design: guests are overcommitted onto zram and ballooning (docs/design/zram-swap.md).

targets.expr: sum(max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"node/.*"})) / sum(max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/.*"}))

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: Space used across every Proxmox storage pool.

targets.expr: sum(max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"})) / sum(max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"}))

panels.title: Nodes, busiest first
panels.description: One row per NUC: offline first, then the fullest memory. Guest memory is what the running guests are configured with, against the node's memory; above 100 % the node relies on ballooning and zram, by design (docs/design/zram-swap.md). Storage is the node's fullest pool. Click a node to open its host dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_limit{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)") / label_replace(max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

sum by (node) ((max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}) and on (id) (max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}) == 1)) * on (id) group_left (node) max by (id, node) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})) / max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"}) / max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "storage/([^/]+)/.*"))

count by (node) (((max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}) == 1) * on (id) group_left (node) max by (id, node) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))) or 0 * max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))
max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_uptime_seconds{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

panels.title: Node CPU used
panels.description: CPU each NUC uses, as a share of its cores.

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

panels.title: Node memory used
panels.description: Memory each NUC uses, as a share of its total.

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace(max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)") / label_replace(max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/.*"}), "node", "$1", "id", "node/(.+)"))

panels.title: Guests, worst first
panels.description: One row per selected VM and container: stopped first, then the fullest memory. CPU used is a share of the guest's own vCPUs; a VM's memory used includes its page cache. Disk used is for containers only; Proxmox cannot see inside a VM's disk. Click a guest to see it alone, its node for the host dashboard, or a Kubernetes VM for its node dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})
(max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})
(max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})
(max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_limit{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})

(max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}) / max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})
(max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})
(max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"lxc/.*"}) / max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"lxc/.*"})) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})
(max by (id) (pve_uptime_seconds{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})
(max by (id) (pve_onboot_status)) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})
max by (id, k8s) (label_replace(pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", name=~"k8s-.*", template="0"}, "k8s", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Guests by state
panels.description: Selected guests running, stopped, and locked (a backup, migration, snapshot or clone holds the guest).

targets.expr: count((max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}) == 1) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})) or vector(0)
count((max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}) == 0) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})) or vector(0)
count((max by (id) (pve_lock_state == 1)) and on (id) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Top 10 guests by CPU
panels.description: Cores used by the ten selected guests busiest over the time range. Click a guest to see it alone.

targets.expr: ((max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"} * pve_cpu_usage_limit{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})) and on (id) topk(10, avg_over_time(((max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"} * pve_cpu_usage_limit{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"}))[$__range:]))

panels.title: Top 10 guests by memory
panels.description: Memory used by the ten selected guests with the most over the time range.

targets.expr: ((max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})) and on (id) topk(10, avg_over_time(((max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"})) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"}))[$__range:]))

panels.title: Guest network
panels.description: Bytes each selected guest sends (above zero) and receives (below zero).

targets.expr: (max by (id) (rate(pve_network_transmit_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})

(max by (id) (rate(pve_network_receive_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})

panels.title: Guest disk
panels.description: Bytes each selected guest writes (above zero) and reads (below zero).

targets.expr: (max by (id) (rate(pve_disk_write_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})
(max by (id) (rate(pve_disk_read_bytes{id=~"qemu/.*|lxc/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})

panels.title: Container disk used
panels.description: Root disk used by each selected container, as a share of its size. VMs are absent: Proxmox cannot see inside their disks.

targets.expr: (max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"lxc/.*"}) / max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"lxc/.*"})) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{name=~"$guest", template="0"})

panels.title: Storage pools, fullest first
panels.description: Space used in each Proxmox storage pool, fullest at the top.

targets.expr: sort_desc((max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"}) / max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"})) * on (id) group_left (node, storage) max by (id, node, storage) (pve_storage_info))

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: Space used in each Proxmox storage pool over time.

targets.expr: (max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"}) / max by (id) (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"})) * on (id) group_left (node, storage) max by (id, node, storage) (pve_storage_info)
